messages.subject: For Noel Wallace | Sustainability, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Colgate-Palmolive Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Noel Wallace, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Colgate-Palmolive's global consumer-health platform operates across governments, communities, water and packaging priorities, and complex sustainability expectations. That interface closely matches my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and stakeholder execution might support Colgate-Palmolive's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Colgate-Palmolive.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
